name: SalesEQ
description: SalesEQ lets you connect your meeting data so you can search calls, review transcripts, share meetings with others, and get AI-powered insights, analytics, and reports

_published_faq.name: How do I add SalesEQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SalesEQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.saleseq.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SalesEQ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SalesEQ provides these MCP tools: get_meeting_frame, get_meeting_summary, get_org_context, get_transcript, list_meetings, and search_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SalesEQ?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SalesEQ in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
SalesEQ requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SalesEQ is developed by SalesEQ, Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
